quest.title: A-Toymaking We Shall Go: Mass Production
quest.description: The three processes have been successfully verified, but Bertrand still seems to have something else to ask of you...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Go to Ritou and look for Bertrand

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: My Toy Factory shall soon be open!

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: *coughs* Well, I mean, it's just me and my Great Machine at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: So, I streamlined the Machine's processes. Now, production should take a lot less time.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: Of course, we're not talking about "instantaneous" levels of speed, but I would at least rate it at "rapid."

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, I made some improvements to the Material Collector as well.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: Previously, you'd need to come back here after each process.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: I thought that was inefficient, so I made some adjustments, and now it updates the current process based on your collection progress.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: Hmm, how should I put this?

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: Let's say that the first process requires 10 Sunsettias, the second needs Hydro and the third will see you defeating 2 Hydro Slimes.

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: And let's say that now you've collected 10 Sunsettias with the Material Collector equipped. Well, in that case, it will consider the materials for the first process collected in full.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, and then it will automatically start the process of collecting materials for the next stage!

dialogues.speaker: Bertrand
dialogues.text: Bingo! It will enter Elemental Charge mode, which will let it collect Hydro energy. And once it finishes collecting Hydro, it will change processes again.

choices.text: It will go on to the third process...

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: Yep, and all you will have to do once that happens is to defeat 2 Hydro Slimes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That does sound a lot more convenient.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: Tell me about it. I pulled an all-nighter to improve it, you know? I personally call it the ultimate foolproof three-in-one...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh. This Material Collector is truly amazing.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Indeed.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: Heh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why would you give this Material Collector to us, though?

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: Hehe, I'm temporarily grounded in Ritou... So I can't collect materials at the moment.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: Come on, help me out here. You can have a bit of the Mora from selling toys and one of the toys for free!

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: Remember the ticket you got? Hehe, well, it can get you one free redemption...

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: Well, as long as you've already created that particular toy model, of course.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Excuse me? You mean with all the materials we collected and all the effort we put in, we only deserve a bit of the Mora and one toy?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #That's preposterous! Let's get outta here, {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: Wait... How about a bigger share of the profits and two... maybe three toys?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: OK, that's it. Let's go, Paimon.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: Four! You can have four! But come on, that's as far as I can go!

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: *sigh* You could have all of them, really, if only I wasn't in debt. Sadly, I still owe the International Trade Association a sum of Mora...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: All right, I'll let you off easy this time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* Listen, we chose to help because you needed help, not for the Mora or toys.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: Hehe, and your aid is most appreciated.

response.speaker: Bertrand
response.text: A relief, finally...

choices.text: It will proceed to Core Activation...
